description: This file provides an implementation of a lightweight semaphore class, including platform-specific semaphore wrappers for Windows, macOS, and POSIX systems. It defines the LightweightSemaphore class that manages concurrent access with spinning and blocking mechanisms.

classes.name: Semaphore
classes.description: Platform-specific semaphore wrapper class for Windows, macOS, and POSIX systems.

methods.name: waitWithPartialSpinning
